items.text: Ralph Black built companies in marketing, video production, and windows, and worked in auto parts manufacturing, including negotiating deals with partners in China and Mexico.

He wants to lower property taxes, eliminate them for seniors over a certain age, and stop state tax increases. He supports local control in education and opposes state curriculum mandates. He supports law enforcement, term limits, fair maps, and voter ID. He opposes immigration policies he says strain taxpayers. At a gun rights rally, he said he supports "stand your ground" protections and the right to bear arms.
